title: Hotel room booking calendar
instructions:
Implement an in-memory booking calendar using half-open stays: checkout day is free.

## Files
- `booking.py`

`parse_span(start, end) -> tuple[date, date]` accepts two strings strictly in
`YYYY-MM-DD` form. Invalid dates/formats or start >= end raise `ValueError`.

`BookingCalendar(rooms)` consumes an iterable of unique, nonempty string room names
(these room-name preconditions are guaranteed). Copy it; room ordering is lexical.
Implement these methods:
- `book(booking_id, room, start, end) -> None`: IDs are nonempty strings. Reject an
  existing ID, unknown room, invalid span, or overlap in that room with `ValueError`.
  Adjacent stays are allowed. A failed call must leave all bookings unchanged.
- `cancel(booking_id) -> None`: remove a booking; missing ID raises `KeyError`.
  A canceled ID may be reused.
- `available(start, end) -> list[str]`: sorted room names with no overlapping stay.
  Validate the span even when there are no rooms.
- `bookings(room=None) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str]]`: fresh list of
  `(booking_id, room, start, end)` using original ISO strings, sorted by
  `(start, room, booking_id)`. With a room argument, filter to it; unknown room
  raises `ValueError`. No argument returns all bookings.
Overlap means `a_start < b_end and b_start < a_end`. All date arguments are strings;
all IDs and room arguments have the guaranteed types above. No persistence is needed.
